instruction: Mark all emails in the INBOX folder as read

rules.sql: select sum(1) > 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in INBOX (folderID=1) as read. The evaluator checks if attributeID=59 (read attribute) is set to value=1 for messages in INBOX. Verified from database: INBOX has 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: SQL query only checks if at least one email is marked as read (sum(1) > 0), not if ALL emails are marked as read
Instruction requires ALL emails to be marked as read, but evaluator will pass even if only 1 out of 2 emails is marked as read
The query logic is fundamentally flawed for verifying the complete task requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change SQL query to: 'select (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 1);' to verify all emails are read

Alternative query: 'select count(*) = 0 from messages where folderID = 1 and id not in (select messageID from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1);' to check there are no unread emails in INBOX
Current query with 'sum(1) > 0' only verifies partial completion, not full task completion
